files.README.txt: Photo mirror notes: originals live in ~/photos, the backup disk mounts at /mnt/backup.

turns.prompt: I keep my photos in ~/photos and want to mirror them to /mnt/backup/photos, copying only what changed. Give me the command with a dry run so I can preview what it would do. Don't run it, I'll do that after reading it.
